llm.summary: MergeGuard is a straightforward code-review prompt that helps an agent inspect PRs or diffs before merge, with no hidden install behavior or executable payloads.

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is pre-merge review of AI-generated code, and its requested capabilities fit that purpose: inspect PRs, diffs, changed files, tests, CI context, and security/privacy risks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to review workflow and output structure. They do not request secret collection, hidden actions, persistence, destructive changes, or bypassing user control.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation and a static SVG banner only; no executable scripts, package installs, dependencies, or install hooks were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may cause an agent to read repository content and run a small validation command when asked to review code, which is expected for the purpose but should only be used on codebases the user is comfortable exposing to the agent environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background worker, persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, credential/session store access, or automatic repository mutation behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a stricter review prompt for AI-generated PRs or diffs. Expect it to inspect repository changes, pasted code, test output, and possibly run a focused validation command when tools are available; avoid using it on private code you do not want your agent environment to read.
